items.title: Carbon-Taxed Transformers: A Green Compression Pipeline for Overgrown Language Models
items.authors: A. I. Alam, P. R. Roy, C. K. Roy, B. Roy and K. A. Schneider
items.venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering (PACMSE), FSE 2026
items.description: Winner of the ACM SIGSOFT Distinguished Paper Award. Introduces Carbon-Taxed Transformers (CTT), a green compression pipeline inspired by carbon-taxation economics that achieves up to 49x memory reduction and up to 81% lower CO2 emissions while retaining roughly 98% clone-detection accuracy across multiple transformer architectures.

items.title: Carbon-Taxed Transformers: Efficient, Accurate, and Sustainable LLMs
items.authors: A. I. Alam, P. R. Roy, C. K. Roy, B. Roy and K. A. Schneider
items.venue: 34th ACM International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering (FSE), Poster Track
items.description: A poster summarizing Carbon-Taxed Transformers (CTT), a pipeline for efficient, accurate, and sustainable large language models applied to software engineering tasks.

items.title: Are Classical Clone Detectors Good Enough For the AI Era?
items.authors: A. I. Alam, P. R. Roy, F. Al-omari, C. K. Roy, B. Roy and K. A. Schneider
items.venue: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution (ICSME)
items.description: Evaluates the effectiveness of classical clone detection tools in the modern AI era, analyzing their performance against AI-generated code and proposing improvements for contemporary software development.

items.title: Towards Just-In-Time, Inclusive Clone Refactoring
items.venue: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution (ICSME)
items.description: Proposes a just-in-time approach to clone refactoring that is inclusive and automated, leveraging large language models and RAG techniques for trustworthy code maintenance.

items.title: Gptclonebench: A comprehensive benchmark of semantic clones and cross-language clones using gpt-3 model and semanticclonebench
items.authors: A. I. Alam, P. R. Roy, F. Al-Omari, C. K. Roy, B. Roy, and K. A. Schneider
items.venue: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution (ICSME)
items.description: Presents a benchmark for evaluating semantic code clones and cross-language clones generated using GPT-3.

items.title: Unveiling the potential of large language models in generating semantic and cross-language clones
items.authors: P. R. Roy, A. I. Alam, F. Al-omari, B. Roy, C. K. Roy, and K. A. Schneider
items.venue: 2023 IEEE 17th International Workshop on Software Clones (IWSC)
items.description: Explores how large language models can generate semantic code clones and cross-language clones, analyzing their potential applications and implications.

items.title: A study on paper and author ranking
items.authors: P. R. Roy, M. N. Islam, L. T. Jeba, et al.
items.venue: 2022 International Conference on Innovations in Science, Engineering and Technology (ICISET)
items.description: Examines methodologies for ranking academic papers and authors, analyzing citation patterns and impact metrics in scientific literature.
